before: A font pick wrote w:ascii and w:hAnsi only, and the font picker read the Latin face of every run.
after: A font pick over East Asian text also writes w:eastAsia through the same w:rFonts merge, and the picker reads the face each span paints in.
reason: The write uses the existing slot-wise w:rFonts merge operation. Released participants read w:eastAsia with the same meaning, so shared data and updates keep their interpretation.
